author.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

challenge.name: The Missing Gate
challenge.description: A critical compliance audit has revealed that our model promotion process lacks a formal quality gate. #requirements_reuben# insists that acceptance criteria must be fully automated and governed to meet security standards, and he will not compromise on this. #automation_alex# argues that the current manual checks are sufficient for now and that building an automated gate will delay the release of new features.

output.content: The current manual KPI tracking is too inconsistent to support our strategic alignment. I need the system to automatically calculate and report these metrics against our defined business goals. Every additional layer of automation here makes the data more reliable and gives me greater confidence in our performance evaluations. I want the KPI definitions to be fully automated so that we can track progress without human error or delay. The more consistent the tracking, the better our ability to align ML features with the broader product roadmap and organizational objectives.
output.reclassify_reason: The statement explicitly links increased automation to greater reliability and confidence, indicating that exceeding the baseline request for automation would make the author happier.
